goal: In 30 days: every public page read by Google and Bing, the strongest ~150 pages indexed first, impressions growing week on week, and search visitors reaching the pricing page and buying.
rules: White-hat only: no bought links, link networks, link farms, mass directory blasts or comment spam. These can get the whole site penalised.
Every live page change is an approval card that names the full page address, the section of the page and the exact new text.
Every outreach email is a draft the owner reads and sends. Nothing is sent automatically to people outside CVTara.
No page or email mentions AI, model names or the companies behind them.
Do not ask Google to index thin pages. Strengthen or merge them first.

weeks.title: Week 1: make every page worth indexing
tasks: Scan all ~600 pages daily; fix any page that is slow, has a duplicate title or has fewer than 300 words of its own.
Offer the 4 pricing pages and the 30 strongest guides to Google first (Indexing API 200 a day, IndexNow for Bing and Yandex).
Owner: add the site in Bing Webmaster Tools (import from Search Console) and submit sitemap.xml there.
Owner: create the Google Business Profile (service-area business, Bangalore) and the LinkedIn company page link to cvtara.com.

weeks.title: Week 2: links from real, relevant sites
tasks: Send 10 placement-cell partnership drafts a day (owner approves each one): free resume sessions for students, a resource link on the college site.
Submit to the free, editor-reviewed listings in the sprint list (startup and software directories, one per day, no bulk tools).
Pitch writers of 'best resume builder in India' articles with an honest product note and the ₹99 price.
Daily: Google URL Inspection on up to 600 pages, recrawl requests for pages that changed.

weeks.title: Week 3: pages close to page 1
tasks: For every search at position 4 to 30: one approval card with a better title, a sharper first paragraph or links from 3 to 5 related pages.
Add FAQ answers for real questions people searched (from Search Console) to the pages that rank for them.
Follow up pitches from week 2 once, 5 days after the first email. Never more than one follow-up.

weeks.title: Week 4: turn visits into revenue
tasks: Compare which pages bring visitors who open the pricing page and who buy; give those pages more internal links.
Test one change at a time on the pricing page (headline or order of plans), never fake urgency or fake reviews.
Month report: pages indexed, impressions, clicks, sign-ups and purchases from search, compared with day 1.

engines.name: Google
engines.how: Sitemap in Search Console (done), Indexing API for changed pages (200 a day), internal links and backlinks. Google stopped accepting sitemap pings in 2023.

engines.name: Bing (also feeds Yahoo, DuckDuckGo and Ecosia)
engines.how: IndexNow (done, automatic), Bing Webmaster Tools: owner imports the site from Search Console and submits the sitemap.

engines.name: Yandex
engines.how: IndexNow (done, automatic); optional Yandex Webmaster account.

engines.name: Answer engines
engines.how: llms.txt (done) and pages that answer one question clearly near the top.
